mapper.select: SELECT id,rental_order_id,factory_id,return_shipment_id,check_status,check_start_source,check_start_at,warning_at,auto_close_at,checked_at,operator_user_id,problem_summary,claim_created,close_reason_code,close_reason,closed_by_user_id,closed_at,version,created_at,updated_at FROM order_return_check WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_return_item_check SET checked_quantity=#{quantity},completed_at=IF(#{quantity}=expected_quantity,#{at},NULL),operator_user_id=#{actor},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE return_check_id=#{checkId} AND rental_order_item_id=#{itemId} AND #{quantity} BETWEEN 0 AND expected_quantity
UPDATE order_return_check SET operator_user_id=#{actor},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND check_status IN ('pending','warning') AND claim_created=0

UPDATE order_return_check SET check_start_source=#{source},check_start_at=#{start},warning_at=DATE_ADD(#{start},INTERVAL 12 HOUR),auto_close_at=DATE_ADD(#{start},INTERVAL 72 HOUR),updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND check_start_at>#{start} AND check_status='pending'
UPDATE order_return_check SET check_status='warning',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND check_status='pending' AND claim_created=0 AND warning_at<=#{at}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_return_scan_record WHERE return_check_id=#{checkId} AND prop_sn_id=#{snId})

SELECT s.rental_order_item_id FROM order_outbound_scan_record s JOIN order_outbound_record o ON o.id=s.outbound_record_id WHERE s.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND s.prop_sn_id=#{snId} AND o.outbound_status='completed'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_return_scan_record s JOIN order_return_check c ON c.id=s.return_check_id WHERE c.rental_order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT order_id FROM ( SELECT s.rental_order_id order_id FROM order_return_shipment s WHERE s.shipment_status='sent' AND s.expected_check_start_at<=#{at} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check c WHERE c.rental_order_id=s.rental_order_id) UNION ALL SELECT c.rental_order_id FROM order_return_check c WHERE c.claim_created=0 AND ((c.check_status='pending' AND c.warning_at<=#{at}) OR (c.check_status='warning' AND c.auto_close_at<=#{at}))) q WHERE order_id>#{afterId} ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 100
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_transport_leg WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND leg_type='return' AND leg_status='completed')
mapper.update: UPDATE order_transport_leg SET leg_status='completed',completed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND leg_type='return' AND leg_status IN ('ready','dispatched')
mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM r WHERE r.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND r.reservation_status='completed' ORDER BY r.id
